courses.subject: MPHR
courses.title: Seminar in PACE
courses.description: This course is required for all Pharmaceutical Sciences graduate students. Other students must obtain permission from the divisional course director. Class format consists of seminar presentations by students and/or faculty or invited speakers. Students are expected to actively engage in seminar activities and discussions.

courses.subject: MPHR
courses.title: Research in Pharmaceutical Sciences
courses.description: This is a variable credit course required for all Pharmaceutical Sciences graduate students by their second semester. Teaching/learning methods consist of a pharmaceutical sciences-based mentored research training experience involving independent work and research reports that must be filed at the end of the semester.

courses.subject: MPHR
courses.title: Master's (Non-Thesis)
courses.description: Students register for thesis substitute credits after successfully passing their comprehensive written examinations. A minimum of 3 credit hours of thesis substitute research and writing is required for Pharmaceutical Sciences graduate students.

source.text: MPHR 992. | 3 Credits. | Prerequisite, PHRS 991 or MPHR 991 .

courses.subject: MPHR
courses.title: Master's Research and Thesis
courses.description: Students register for thesis credits after successfully passing their comprehensive written examination. A minimum of 3 credit hours of thesis research and writing is required for Pharmaceutical Sciences graduate students.

source.text: MPHR 993. | 3 Credits. | Prerequisite, PHRS 991 or MPHR 991 .
